emails.subject: Quote MP-2214 - repaint Unit 2B, 12 Brixton Lane
emails.body: Hi, thanks for walking me through the unit. Quote MP-2214 comes to $480 to repaint the bedroom walls and touch up the trim in Unit 2B at 12 Brixton Lane. My crew can start Thursday, August 6, and we are out in two days. Reply to confirm and I'll pencil you in. - Odalys Delgadillo, Delgadillo Painting

emails.subject: Unit 2B carpet steam clean - your quote
emails.body: Hello, steam cleaning the living room carpet in Unit 2B with stain treatment included comes to $175. I have Monday, August 10 open if that works with your painter's schedule. - Harlan Boyce, Boyce Carpet Care

emails.subject: Is Unit 2B still available for September 1?
emails.body: Hi, I saw the listing for 12 Brixton Lane and I'd love a tour next week if the September 1 move-in is still on the table. Any weekday evening works for me. - Yolanda Halloway
